description: This file defines a CLI output parser for handling nd-json output from the kilocode CLI, including parsing JSON lines, handling ANSI escape codes, buffering partial lines, and generating structured stream events.

classes.name: CliOutputParser
classes.description: A class for parsing chunks of CLI output streams, buffering partial data, and extracting structured events.

methods.name: tryParseJson
methods.description: Attempts to parse a line as JSON, trying both raw and ANSI-stripped versions.

methods.name: parseCliChunk
methods.description: Parses a chunk of CLI output, handling buffering of partial lines and converting lines into stream events.

methods.name: extractJsonObjects
methods.description: Extracts multiple JSON objects from a line, handling nested braces and string literals.

methods.name: createOutputEvent
methods.description: Creates an output stream event with the given content.
